newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay adds 2 new flights to Kuala Lumpur.
newsitem.headline: Cathay adds 2 new flights to Kuala Lumpur.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Limited said it has added two extra flights per week between Hong Kong and the Malaysian capital Kuala Lumpur.

The two new morning flights depart Hong Kong at 10.25 am on Mondays and Fridays complementing existing daily afternoon services and brings the number of Cathay flights between the two cities to 11 per week.

"The increase in capacity is in response to customer demand for more frequencies between Hong Kong and Malaysia," James Yeung, the airline's general manager for south east Asian and Middle eastern routes said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
